questions.original: So, how do you decide m? What if m=1 or 2?

answers.chinese: 用相同预测步长的顺序验证比较窗口

answers.chinese: m=1 沿用最后值，m=2 平均最后两值
answers.english: With m=1 use the last observed value; with m=2 average the last two observations.
